rationale: The success message in contact-form.jekyll.html (lines 15-20) uses inline styles with hardcoded colors (#d4edda, #c3e6cb, #155724) that don't match the site's color scheme variables. This creates visual inconsistency and makes maintenance harder.
problemSolved: Success message uses inline styles: 'style="padding: 20px; background: #d4edda; border: 1px solid #c3e6cb; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 20px;"' which conflicts with the site's design system using $primary-color and $global-radius variables.
